method: read-only live pg_catalog, information_schema, pg_policies, storage.buckets; no application row reads

tables.name: battle_maps
tables.projection: Separate authorized dimensions from Storage paths and map metadata; do not return raw storage paths by default

tables.name: campaign_handouts
tables.policy: DM or campaign member for revealed handout or exposed visible map pin
tables.projection: Reveal text only when server-proved revealed/exposed-pin scope; no SELECT * to players

tables.name: campaign_map_pins
tables.policy: DM or visible pin for member authorized for map
tables.projection: Do not send hidden pin coordinates or handout metadata in Realtime

tables.name: campaign_members
tables.projection: Return minimum roster fields only to signed current campaign members

tables.name: campaign_tool_issues
tables.policy: DM, owning recipient, or party-shared membership
tables.projection: Owner/DM-specific config and state, never assume party_shared grants every private field

tables.name: characters
tables.policy: owner or campaign DM can select row
tables.projection: Owner/DM-only private field_values; player-facing token roster uses a separate bounded projection

tables.name: map_combat_entries
tables.projection: Return player-visible initiative through get_authorized_map_combat, not private token_id map

tables.name: map_environments
tables.projection: No direct prepared/live scene JSON to players; use authorized scene generation and fog mask

tables.name: map_tokens
tables.policy: DM or visible/observed row; authenticated base-table SELECT absent
tables.projection: Never grant direct authenticated SELECT; signed authorized visible-roster projection only

tables.name: npc_templates
tables.projection: DM-only private NPC sheet; no raw player template SELECT

cautions: pg_catalog grants and RLS policy text are metadata, not proof of original function transitive correctness
RLS governs rows, not automatic column projection
The 19 source Postgres Changes declarations have no select projections; DELETE/old connected sockets need real testing
The signed URL cache clears local references but cannot invalidate an already issued bearer URL
get_campaign_sheet_inventory is a SECURITY DEFINER read-looking RPC that can normalize and WRITE _inventoryId via UPDATE; do not classify as read-only
get_authorized_map_combat is actor/map authorized and projects observed participants, but retains private DM-only combat entry mapping
Original public schema authenticated USAGE remains enabled; no hosted R128/V3 cutover
No real DM/P1/P2/outsider/multi-tab authorization, LOS, collision or free-tier latency test has been run

reviewedFunctionExamples.behaviour: reads AND conditionally writes normalized inventory UUIDs

reviewedFunctionExamples.permission: can_view_campaign_map and observed player roster; private DM mapping separate
